activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, showering and brushing teeth
Making and eating breakfast, drinking tea, taking a quick look at phone
Getting dressed in work clothes, packing work bag and checking the day's patient schedule
Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing inpatients, delivering individual rehabilitation therapy sessions and documenting treatment notes
Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating a packed meal and resting briefly
Continuing physiotherapy work: running outpatient exercise sessions, reviewing treatment progress and coordinating with ward colleagues
Washing hands and changing out of work clothes
Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping the counters
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing the phone
Reading rehabilitation research articles on the computer and doing light stretching exercises
Nightly routine: brushing teeth and washing up
Setting the alarm and going to sleep
